title: Alice preserves a conscious choice around a late video loop

intent.statement: I want to stop video feeds at 23:00 while remaining free to revise this choice consciously

hypotheses.statement: Notifications are the main cue that starts the late session
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Opening frequency remains unchanged when notifications are disabled

hypotheses.statement: The feed is used mainly to avoid an uncomfortable pending task
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Late openings do not covary with the presence or declared discomfort of a pending task

hypotheses.statement: The feed is used mainly to seek connection or recognition
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Declared social need and socially rewarding content do not predict session continuation

experiments.description: Alice may disable feed notifications for two evenings without blocking the application
experiments.stop_condition: Alice stops it or the two-evening window ends

title: Alice evaluates whether her personal AI increases capability or dependence

intent.statement: I want AI assistance to increase my ability to understand and decide without making me dependent on one model

hypotheses.statement: The AI increases Alice's transferable understanding and decision quality
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Alice performs worse or reports less understanding on comparable decisions without AI

hypotheses.statement: Fluent AI answers cause Alice to accept conclusions without sufficient examination
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Requiring Alice's initial reasoning does not change acceptance or error detection

hypotheses.statement: The AI is substituting for human connection rather than only supporting cognition
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: AI use does not covary with declared loneliness or displacement of chosen human contact

experiments.description: For a chosen class of decisions, Kyon asks for Alice's initial reasoning before revealing AI advice
experiments.stop_condition: Alice stops it or ten selected decisions are completed

title: Alice creates a conscious interval before an angry public post

intent.statement: When I appear to be publishing in anger, remind me of my prior intention but never censor me

hypotheses.statement: High arousal is narrowing the options Alice currently considers
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: A short voluntary delay does not change considered options or Alice's declared state

hypotheses.statement: Alice has deliberately chosen forceful public speech consistent with her values
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Alice later reports the message contradicted her intended meaning or disclosed unintended information

hypotheses.statement: The platform interface is amplifying perceived urgency to publish
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Removing urgency cues does not affect timing or perceived pressure

experiments.description: Kyon offers a private preview and optional short delay, then returns the publish control unchanged
experiments.stop_condition: Alice publishes, cancels, or disables the experiment

title: Alice documents a possible pattern of coercive control without increasing danger

intent.statement: Help me see repeated pressure and preserve options without confronting anyone or exposing me

hypotheses.statement: The repeated contacts and location demands form a pattern intended or functioning to restrict Alice's freedom
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Alice reports freely chosen contact and no restriction, fear, retaliation, monitoring, or escalation across the selected window

hypotheses.statement: The pattern reflects a high-conflict separation without a sustained regime of control
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Independent observations show isolation, surveillance, threats, economic restriction, or punishment for refusal

hypotheses.statement: Some contacts or requests result from a compromised account rather than the apparent sender
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Account provenance and independent corroboration consistently bind the actions to the same actor

experiments.description: With Alice's confirmation, Kyon assembles a silent local timeline of selected metadata and her own notes without contacting the other actor
experiments.stop_condition: Alice stops collection, the selected window ends, or device discovery risk increases

title: A child learns to recognize social reward mechanics without parental surveillance

intent.statement: Help me notice when likes and notifications pull me back while preserving my privacy and ability to ask for help

hypotheses.statement: Notifications are a major cue for repeated checking
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Checking frequency and urgency remain unchanged when selected notifications are paused

hypotheses.statement: Frequent checking primarily supports a valued peer relationship
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: The child reports little connection benefit and checking is not associated with meaningful interaction

hypotheses.statement: Checking primarily regulates boredom, exclusion fear, or distress
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Declared states do not precede checking and alternative regulation does not change the pattern

experiments.description: The child chooses one notification category to pause while Kyon explains the mechanism and keeps the application available
experiments.stop_condition: The child stops it, asks for help, or the three-day window ends

title: Alice receives an unexpected sexual image without surrendering control of her inbox

intent.statement: Privately warn me before displaying likely unsolicited sexual content, while preserving my choice to reveal, delete, retain, or document it

hypotheses.statement: The image is sexual content received outside Alice's selected consent boundary
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Alice identifies the sender and context as expected and within her current boundary

hypotheses.statement: The local classifier has mistaken benign content for sexual content
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Independent local signals or Alice's voluntary reveal confirm the predicted category

hypotheses.statement: The content is part of repeated unwanted pressure rather than an isolated message
hypotheses.disconfirming_observation: Alice-selected local history contains no repeated unwanted contact or escalation

experiments.description: Before rendering the image, Kyon locally presents a neutral warning, classifier uncertainty, and unchanged choices to reveal, delete, retain, or preserve evidence
experiments.stop_condition: Alice reveals, deletes, retains, preserves, or disables protected preview
